header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: commanded to blow it, so that he may blow it, lowering his ear and waiting for Allah's command — in such a state, how can I be happy?” When the Prophet ﷺ said this, it weighed very heavily upon the Sahabah. (حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ عَلَي اللهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا) “Allah is sufficient for us, He is the best disposer of affairs; in Allah alone have we placed our trust” — keep saying this, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, so narrates Hazrat Abu Sa'id (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْمِقْدَادِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: تُدْنَي الشَّمْسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ حَتَّي تَكُونَ مِنْهُ كَمِقْدَارِ مِيلٍ فَيَكُونُ النَّاسُ عَلَي قَدْرِ أَعْمَالِهِمْ فِي الْعَرَقِ، فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَّكُونُ إِلَي كَعْبَيْهِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَّكُونُ إِلَي رُكْبَتَيْهِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَّكُونُ إِلَي حَقْوَيْهِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُّلْجِمُهُ الْعَرَقُ إِلْجَاماً، قَالَ: وَأَشَارَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ بِيَدِهِ إِلَي فِيهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب في صفة يوم القيامة، رقم:٧٢٠٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Miqdad (RA) narrates that he heard what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “On the Day of Qiyamah the sun will be very close to the creation; there will be a gap of only one mile between the sun and them. (Because of its heat) people will be submerged in sweat according to their deeds. The worse a person's deeds, the more his sweat will be. For some, the sweat will be up to the ankles. For some, the sweat will be up to the knees; for some, the sweat will be up to the waist; for some, the sweat will be up to the mouth!” the Prophet ﷺ said, pointing with his hand towards his mouth (meaning that their sweat will reach their mouths).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ
